_comentario: How the kiosk UNDERSTANDS what people say in English (registro/Conversacion). What the kiosk SAYS is not here: it is in the catalog (context «totem», i18n/ba_en.ts). The word lists are compared against the speech-to-text output once flattened (lowercase, without the accents in «aplanar» and with punctuation as spaces): so a contraction is written with a space where the apostrophe was («don t know», «that s right»). Only «nombre» keeps the apostrophe («i'm»). A phrase is several words separated by one space. What the kiosk says has to be answerable with these lists: the catalog confirmation (“Say “yes, that's correct”…”) with the ones in «respuestas». See docs/desarrollo/I18N.md, «Tótem: datos del idioma».

aplanar._comentario: Letter (UTF-8) → what it becomes when flattened. Anything not listed here that is not ASCII is dropped. A space: taken as a separator. The typographic apostrophe becomes the plain one (so «I’m» and «I'm» are the same).

numeros._comentario: Numbers said in words. «regla» «en» (Conversacion.cpp, grupo()): the hundred MULTIPLIES the unit before it («two hundred», «a hundred» or a bare «hundred» = 100), optionally followed by a «conectoresCentena» («and») and 1..99; a ten («thirty») optionally followed by its unit («thirty five»: no connector, the hyphen is a space); or a unit (0 to 19). «mil» (thousand) multiplies what comes before (or 1) and adds; «millon» multiplies everything before. «ninguno» counts as zero. «oh» is zero in phone numbers («five five five oh one»). «digitos»: how each digit 0..9 is said, to read back a phone or an email (not flattened).

respuestas._comentario: Yes or no. First «noSabe» (neither yes nor no: ask again) and «noFrases» (a no even if it has a yes inside: «not right»); then, if one of «si» or of «no» appears (and not both), that one. The first of each list is the one used when the model answers with a boolean.

_comentarioListas: cancelar, repetir and saltear: «exactas» = the whole utterance is that; «contiene» = it appears in the utterance (as whole words).

correo._comentario: The dictated email. «signos»: what is said instead of a sign, in order (multi-word phrases are replaced first, then single words). «noSonDigitos»: units of «numeros» that are not turned into a digit («oh» is more often the letter o in an email). «antes» and «despues»: what is said before the email («my email is») and after («thanks»), which is removed. «terminaciones»: domain endings that, standing alone after the at sign, take a dot («gmail com» → gmail.com). «dominios»: a domain said without its ending that is completed. «decir»: how each sign is read back aloud.

telefono._comentario: «mas»: what is said for the + of the country code (only at the start); «decirMas», how it is read back. «repetir»: «double five» = 55, «triple zero» = 000. «grupo»: how many digits are read and shown together (the first group takes the remainder: 55 5123 4567).

nombre._comentario: «antes»: what is said before the name, in order (the first one that matches at the start is removed, and again, until none is left). Here the apostrophe stays («i'm»). «despues»: at the end. «noEmpiezaCon»: if the utterance starts like this, it is not a name («no thanks»). «particulas»: lowercase in the middle of a name («Ana María de la Fuente», «Ludwig van Beethoven»).

opciones._comentario: Picking an option by its order: «orden» has, for the first, the second…, how it is named; «ultima», the last one.

_comentarioEtiqueta: etiquetaEnMinuscula: a field label said in the middle of a sentence starts lowercase («Got email…»; an acronym like «ID» stays).
